questions.question: Why does scaling both \(x\) and \(y\) by ten require a different stable step-size range?
options: Autodiff stops working on scaled inputs
questions.explanation: Both the residual scale and its weight derivative scale by ten, so the gradient and curvature scale by \(100\). This is specific to the squared objective and paired scaling.
